rows.text: [Trailblazer], you asleep?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I can't sleep
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I can't sleep either
I can't sleep either
Big sigh, I actually just finished watching a movie
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It said it was based on a true story, about someone with more than twenty alters...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The protagonist had memory lapses. He thought it was just ordinary amnesia, but in truth, it was other alters living his life for him
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Do you think... I might be the same...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Actually... That's right...
Actually... That's right...
Actually... the you from yesterday... wasn't the you today... You were cuter yesterday...
Be nice! I'm cute today, and I'll be even cuter tomorrow!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry, that is impossible
Don't worry. With my God's-eye view, I can see that you are complete
Even if you're teasing, I still feel a little uneasy
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Could there be... other March 7ths out there!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Maybe... March 7th, an eccentric artist? Or March 7th, a socialite femme fatale? That's scary...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't tell me there's an exceptionally intelligent March 7th too...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's fantasy time
Riiight. Fantasy time. You should sleep
When you wake up, you'll still be that adorable, gentle, kind, and innocent girl March 7th
You are the Sword Champion of Astral Express
And don't forget, you are also March 7th, the Sword Champion of Astral Express
Don't worry, you'll still be that adorable, gentle, kind, and innocent girl March 7th
Don't worry, it's fine
Don't worry, it's fine
You'll still be that adorable, gentle, kind, and innocent girl March 7th
You really know how to say the right thing...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Okay, I admit I probably don't care that much anymore
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: After all, I am March 7th, the sociable, generous, wise, charming, clever, adorable, gentle, kind, and innocent girl!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Go to sleep, [Trailblazer]
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Tomorrow, I will wash your bowl for you
rows.speaker: March 7th
